review_method: Re-read the full 1080x608 Pirelli Motorsport RACE SETS chart reproduced by Coffee Corner Motorsport; visually checked all 22 entrants and six cells in soft-new/used, medium-new/used, hard-new/used order. Dashes mean zero. Cross-checked the 22 driver codes, including HIR, against the official Mexico Race classification. Corrected the visual transcription for Stroll (3 new/2 used Softs) and Alonso (4 new/1 used Soft); image SHA-256 unchanged.
